docs.title: Adithya Sri Dappili
docs.text:
I am an MSc Artificial Intelligence in the Biosciences student at Queen Mary University of London with a background in Biomedical Engineering. My interests include machine learning, bioinformatics, computational biology, medical imaging, and biomedical signal processing.

I have experience developing deep learning and machine learning solutions for healthcare applications, including Parkinson's disease detection from vocal biomarkers, medical image analysis, and biosensor-based diagnostics. GitHub](https://github.com/adithyadappili) · LinkedIn

docs.text: As part of my MSc Artificial Intelligence in the Biosciences at Queen Mary University of London, I have been developing practical skills in Linux, Git, GitHub, Python, and bioinformatics workflows.

docs.title: Parkinson's Disease Early Detection Using Vocal Biomarkers
Context
docs.text: This project focused on identifying early indicators of Parkinson's disease using acoustic speech signals and machine learning methods.

docs.title: My Contribution
docs.text:
• Developed machine learning and deep learning classification pipelines using Python.
  • Extracted acoustic features including MFCCs, jitter, shimmer, and pitch perturbation measurements.
  • Trained and evaluated multiple models including MLP, SVM, and Random Forest classifiers.
  • Compared model performance using sensitivity, specificity, and ROC-AUC metrics.

docs.title: Outcome
docs.text: The project demonstrated how AI techniques can support early disease detection from non-invasive speech data and strengthened my skills in biomedical AI, machine learning, and healthcare analytics.
